images.name: 窗边手帖
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing edit. Create ONE professional finished LANDSCAPE game UI interaction design board, ratio about 16:11. Board header: "31  窗边手帖  /  Window Journal" and small brand "Little Elsewhere". Input image 1 is a LOCKED game screenshot: INSERT THIS EXACT UNALTERED SCENERY as the hero viewport. Do not reinterpret, repaint, recolor, simplify, move, remove or add any scene object. Preserve left tree and birds, original window frame, balcony, potted plants, coffee mug, green book, feeder, broad curving river, opposite town, snow mountains, sun and sky. Only overlay designed interface elements over this picture. No full-screen tint. No new scenery art.
Board composition: thin off-white header 5%, upper 65% large complete 16:9 hero game viewport, bottom 28% separate off-white interaction-detail strip OUTSIDE the game screen. Hero remains spacious; normal HUD occupies roughly 8–12% at margins. This must be a genuinely rich interaction design, not three bare text buttons, nor an enormous decorative permanent side panel.
Direction: Japanese observation journal, delicate warm paper, fine ruled lines, small date stamps, sage accents, charcoal type, lightly hand-drawn bird/weather icons. Restrained not ornate. Main hero top-left slim title/date/weather cluster; top-right compact focus timer with subtle play icon and audio control. Bottom of hero a slim DAY TIMELINE on the windowsill with four small bird visitor avatar pips, times, one unread dot and tiny notebook tab. At bottom-right a small seed/feeding control with fill meter. One small contextual bird label "麻雀 · 第3次来访" points to existing tree bird; tiny "记录" control. Keep river and mountains unobscured. Show counters "12/50", "今日来访 4", "25:00" in appropriate small places.
Bottom interaction-detail strip: three beautifully aligned enlarged UI state panels with thin arrows between them, readable short Chinese headings "观察" → "记录" → "珍藏". First: bird context card with miniature sparrow, familiar-visit 3/5 progress, record action. Second: half-page today journal drawer with three succinct timestamp rows and bird thumbnails, navigation tabs "今日 / 图鉴 / 奇遇". Third: selected sparrow profile with illustrated specimen, discovery date, three small familiar heart stamps, favorite star and "加入珍藏". Show how timeline expands to journal then saves species. Rich purposeful hierarchy, tiny icons and compact controls; no paragraphs of fake text. Bottom strip is outside gameplay, not permanent game HUD.
Finished coherent art-directed UI presentation, crisp readable Chinese, subtle tactile paper and quiet pixel accents. Avoid generic SaaS dashboard, giant book covering scenery, thick decorative frames, glitter, oily paint, plastic, neon, overly saturated palette. All scenic pixels in main viewport should match the reference; style only the UI.

images.name: 口袋观察站

Use case: ui-mockup / compositing. Design ONE finished game UI artboard for the cozy idle nature collection game Little Elsewhere. Board title exactly "35  口袋观察站", subtitle "POCKET FIELDKIT · Little Elsewhere".

Professional landscape design-board composition about 16:11: thin header at top; a large complete original game viewport in the upper two thirds; bottom quarter is a clearly separated off-white sheet with THREE enlarged UI interaction states connected with discreet arrows. These detail panels are outside the gameplay image. No giant side dashboard permanently covering the view.
Visual direction: a softly crafted Japanese pixel field kit. UI ONLY uses sharp pixel-grid icons, one-pixel slate/olive outlines, small stepped corners, parchment-cream surfaces, restrained olive green and dusty blue accents, monospaced numerals with legible Chinese text. Texture is a subtle dot-grid notebook paper, not noisy retro CRT. Keep the background painting identical; only the UI is pixel-designed.
Main view must show rich game interaction in 8–12% edge occupancy, not a few blank text buttons. A compact top-left weather/time chip with tiny sun and cloud pixel symbols, top-right visitor count "今日来访 3" and "图鉴 12/50", a contextual tiny pill near one existing tree bird with "NEW" and a five-square familiarity indicator, a compact bottom tool belt: original pixel binocular icon "观察", seed scoop "投喂", notebook "图鉴", sparkle "奇遇", headphone "陪伴". Clear selected state, focus border, hotkey legend on tool belt as tiny hints (1,2,3), coherent design system and intentional distinct pixel iconography.
Text must be crisp and sparse Chinese words, no fake paragraphs. UI should feel complete, playful, tactility of little pixel tools, readable at game scale. No heavy wood frame, no giant decorative book or vines, no excessive ornament, no glassmorphism, no glossy 3D, no rainbow neon, no debug toolbar. Finished professional game interface design illustration, not an implemented app screenshot and not ten random colored buttons.

No heavy vintage texture, no giant stamps, no wooden/vine frames, no thick carved panels, no glossy 3D, no dashboard grids inside game. Not a complete album permanently consuming the scenery. Never draw new physical props into the landscape. At upper-left a small two-line visiting note with sparrow avatar "麻雀来访" and five familiarity dots. Upper-right tiny weather and log icons, a single discreet "新记录 2" badge. No large heading inside the actual game. Central water and mountains remain completely visible.

Below the main game image, on a light off-white design-board background that is EXPLICITLY NOT part of the game viewport, show three well-sized polished detailed UI states:
1. "翻开图鉴": a compact illustrated field-guide drawer with three category tabs 鸟类 / 昆虫 / 奇遇, 6 species thumbnails including two undiscovered silhouettes, small collection progress 12/50, selected sparrow with favorite star.
2. "补充鸟食": a modest popover with three illustrated seed choices and quantity chips, subtle feeding progress, clear "补充" button and "取消" text button.
3. "开始陪伴": a compact focus card with 25 / 45 / 自定义 duration choices, ambient volume sliders with bird/water/rain icons, one "开始" button and a small discover-later notification queue.
Make these three INTERACTION STATES very clear and useful with actual controls and information hierarchy. Not a row of ornamental stickers. They must be readable enough to evaluate the design.

Short Chinese words above must be legible and correct. Avoid long fake paragraphs. Board title exactly "40  窗台工作台" and smaller "Little Elsewhere / Windowsill Atelier". Use restrained fine lines and plenty of breathing room, consistent icon grammar. No game engine chrome, no debug toolbar, no giant UI panels over the scenery, no glowing sci-fi dashboard, no oily paint, no heavy woodcarving, no vines or fantasy frames. The original background must stay visually unchanged. This is a DESIGN IMAGE, not implementation or a generic web dashboard.
